title: big tech backed coalition carbon removal increases funding by 915 million adds 2026 06 17
text:
LONDON, June 17 (Reuters) - A coalition backed by Big Tech companies for carbon removal technology, said on Wednesday it would ​inject an additional $915 million into the sector, ​and added Anthropic as a new participant.
(This story has been corrected to remove Salesforce, which is not a new participant but an existing member of the coalition, from paragraph 1)
